item.title: Avon Lake wrestling: Ieropoli wins sectional title, Shoremen send entire lineup to Perrysburg District
item.description: This season has been a long time coming for Ambrose Ieropoli. item.title: Bibee gives up three runs in first inning; Guardians fall to White Sox, 7-5
item.description: Tanner Bibee gave up three runs in the first inning of the Guardians’ 7-5 loss to the White Sox on Feb. 28 in the Cactus League. After getting the first batter to fly out, Bibee gave up a home run and two doubles to three consecutive batters. He also threw a wild pitch that allowed a run to score later in the inning. item.title: Monsters beat Penguins, 2-1, in overtime, improve to 10-6 in OT
item.description: The Monsters excel at playing more than 60 minutes of hockey. They love playing in front of big crowds. Both things happened Feb. 28 in front of 14,408 fans in Rocket Arena when Jack Williams scored 1:55 into overtime to give the Monsters a well-earned 2-1 victory over the Wilkes-Barre/Scranton Penguins less than 24 hours after the Penguins nipped the Monsters, 3-2, with 13,190 fans in attendance. The Feb. 28 game was scrappy. The Penguins seemed determined to lure Monsters players into fights.
